_comment: Paste each object in this array as a separate Tool in the Vapi dashboard (Tools > Create Tool > Function), or POST it to https://api.vapi.ai/tool. Replace BASE_URL with this backend's public URL once deployed (e.g. https://your-app.up.railway.app).

function.name: lookup_patient_by_phone
function.description: Check whether a patient already exists in the system by phone number. Call this as soon as the caller gives their phone number, before collecting any other information, so you can detect a returning caller.

phone_number.description: The caller's 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only or with punctuation.

function.name: register_patient
function.description: Create a new patient record. Only call this AFTER you have read back every collected field to the caller and they have explicitly confirmed it is correct. If this returns success=false with error='duplicate_phone', tell the caller a record already exists for that phone number and ask if they'd like to update it instead (then use update_patient).

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format

sex.description: One of: Male, Female, Other, Decline to Answer

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient record, identified by patient_id (obtained from lookup_patient_by_phone). Only include fields the caller actually wants to change. Call this only after reading back the changes and getting explicit confirmation.

patient_id.description: The existing patient's unique ID, from lookup_patient_by_phone

function.name: schedule_appointment
function.description: Bonus feature: offer to schedule the patient's first appointment using mock availability data (no real calendar integration). Only call this after registration or an update has already succeeded, and only if the caller says yes when asked.

patient_id.description: The patient's unique ID, from register_patient or update_patient
